name: Encode and numerals
summary: Base64, URL, HTML, hex encoding, Roman numerals and number words
author: friday-core
description: Encoders and numeral systems in both directions. It holds 3 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. Text encoder: URL escapes, HTML entities, Base64, hex and \u escapes, both directions. Roman numerals: Whole numbers 1 to 3999 to Roman numerals and back. Number words: English words for a number, its ordinal, and words back to a number.
